title: Model Version Wind-Down: Automated Pinning Alerts, Migration Recipes, and Notice Cadence
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Define and implement a repeatable wind-down workflow for deprecated model versions that (1) preserves customer continuity via explicit pinning and aliasing, (2) publishes performance profiles and compatibility notes, and (3) delivers an automated notice cadence with one-click migration recipes. Scope includes Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private deployments; Console UX for pin alerts; SDK warnings; and customer comms templates.

Success criteria:
- Customers who have pinned deprecated versions receive targeted notices and a migration recipe; <10% manual migrations required for users with standard prompts.
- Console surfaces active pins, estimated compatibility effort, and a safe migration button that creates test runs.
- Performance profiles for replacement model variants published and linked in migration guides.
- Deprecation notices follow a 90/60/30/7/0 day cadence and are recorded in audit logs.

Stakeholders: PM (Asha), Eng leads (Runtime: Priya Rao, Console: Miguel Torres), Design (Sofia Rivera), Customer Success (Dana Kim), Legal & Security (review required for Private deployments).

Out-of-scope: full automated model-weight conversion; heavy customer-specific migrations that require bespoke engineering (will be handled as Professional Services).
comments: 2026-03-10 - Initial kickoff: agreed on 90/60/30/7/0 cadence and that Console should show a per-customer pin report. Action: ENG to scope API telemetry (Priya).
2026-03-11 - Design @Sofia: mockups for Pin Insights panel shared (Figma link: https://figma.redwood/designs/pin-insights). Need to add 'Estimated regression risk' field.

2026-03-12 - Eng review: Runtime team proposes a compatibility-check job that runs a sampled prompt set against candidate replacement and returns pass/fail + perf delta. Ticket ENG-40210 created for compatibility job infra.

2026-03-13 - PM decision: Migration recipes should include three paths: automatic alias swap (low-risk), guided re-parameterization (medium), and manual evaluation harness (high). Document templates in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/model-winddown.

2026-03-14 - Console integration plan: Miguel will add 'Migrate' action which kicks off a dry-run on the customer's pinned prompts and shows token cost delta. UX acceptance criteria: dry-run under 2 minutes for 95% of customers. PR stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/6792
2026-03-14 - Note: Dedicated/Private customers require an opt-in webhook to receive notices (privacy constraint). Legal to review notice language for regulated customers (Dana assigned).
notes:
Implementation details: add API telemetry label 'deprecated_pin_detected' and surface in Console Pin Insights. SDKs should emit a runtime warning when a pinned version is close to sunset. Migration recipes will be packaged as a JSON manifest with 'pin_version', 'replacement_variant', 'expected_perf_delta', and 'migration_steps' keys. Audit logs must capture customer acceptance of migration.

Risks: customer churn for latency-sensitive workloads if replacements increase tail latency; legal/regulatory blockers for Private customers. Mitigations: compatibility dry-runs, performance profile publishing, and staggered rollout with canary opt-in.
